chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played Gorou — Inuzaka All-Round Defense, All Streams Flow to the Sea, and two copies of Water's Edge, all targeting Sludge Spinner, for 31 total damage.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered replacing one Water's Edge with Coral Guard, dealing 25 damage while gaining 5 Block and reducing the incoming damage from 8 to 3.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up 5 Block and therefore 5 HP in exchange for 6 additional damage, leaving Sludge Spinner at 7 HP.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. A substantially larger attack intent would have made me replace a Water's Edge with Coral Guard, and a non-attacking intent would have made the all-damage line even clearer.
